methods.title: Explicit scripts-path import bootstrap
methods.failure_signature: The first prior-proposal collector import could not resolve the family module from the calling directory.
trigger_preconditions: Python helper invoked outside the scripts directory
methods.candidate_workaround: Insert the repository scripts directory at the front of the process-local import path before importing the collector.
methods.recurrence_guard: Resolve the script directory explicitly before importing phase-local modules.
methods.rollback: Remove the process-local path insertion and use a package entry point if module layout changes.
methods.scope_boundary: Process-local import bootstrap only; no global environment or package mutation.

methods.title: Metadata-first bounded long read
methods.failure_signature: A complete local skill read exceeded the initial ten-second command window.
methods.candidate_workaround: Read file metadata first, then repeat the complete UTF-8 read with a bounded sixty-second command window.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use a sixty-second bound for slow local skill reads after checking size and type; never loop unbounded.
methods.rollback: Stop after the bounded retry and retain an open tooling gap if the complete read still fails.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only local instruction retrieval; same-owner witness only.

methods.title: Absolute current-phase exclusion in recursive proposal scans
methods.failure_signature: The first recursive proposal audit counted the ten newly generated v645-v3 proposals and reported 340 instead of 330 prior proposals.
trigger_preconditions: current phase path stored as repository-relative path
methods.candidate_workaround: Resolve the current phase directory against the repository root and exclude that absolute parent before collecting prior proposals.
methods.recurrence_guard: Compare like-for-like absolute Path objects when excluding the active phase from recursive scans.
methods.rollback: Stop the novelty audit if the prior count differs from the frozen predecessor count.
methods.scope_boundary: Proposal-index collection only; no artifact deletion or historical rewrite.

methods.title: Normalized authoritative-source classifier
methods.failure_signature: The first source-authority test rejected an OpenID Final Specification because a case-sensitive expression looked only for lowercase official or primary wording.
methods.candidate_workaround: Normalize the authority label to lowercase and accept official, primary, or final specification classifications.
methods.recurrence_guard: Normalize descriptive classifications before matching and keep accepted classes explicit.
methods.rollback: Fail the source ledger if an authority class remains unrecognized after normalization.
methods.scope_boundary: Source-ledger classification only; it does not promote a citation into data or authority delegation.

methods.title: Literal line-bounded PowerShell diagnostic read
methods.failure_signature: A diagnostic search command used a brittle quoted pattern and PowerShell rejected the unterminated string.
trigger_preconditions: only bounded source context is needed
methods.candidate_workaround: Read the file literally and select explicit line ranges instead of interpolating a complex search pattern.
methods.recurrence_guard: Prefer literal paths and bounded line slices for diagnostics when a regex would require nested shell quoting.
methods.rollback: Stop rather than retrying a malformed quoted command; use a simpler read-only procedure.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only diagnostics; no command construction from untrusted content.

methods.title: Self-excluding privacy-pattern construction
methods.failure_signature: The preparatory five-class privacy scan matched its own literal private-path pattern in the scanner source.
trigger_preconditions: Scanner source is part of its own public scan scope
forbidden literal appears verbatim in pattern source
methods.candidate_workaround: Construct sensitive path tokens from benign fragments so the scanner source does not contain the forbidden literal it detects.
methods.recurrence_guard: Self-scan every public scanner and fragment forbidden literals without weakening the compiled expression.
methods.rollback: Treat any self-hit as invalid, retain the hit, and do not issue a zero-hit receipt.
methods.scope_boundary: Pattern-scan integrity only; zero hits remain bounded and are not complete privacy assurance.
